name: camayoc_work_per_token
description: verification-and-liveness Q18: the two legs of work-per-token for a principal — items closed, and total tokens consumed. The ratio is left to the reader: dividing here would hide a zero denominator. Caveat, stated because it is SPARQL's doing: SUM over no records is 0, and 0-consumption and unmeasured are different claims — run Q19 (camayoc_sessions_without_usage) before believing a zero here.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT ?itemsClosed ?tokensConsumed WHERE { { SELECT (COUNT(DISTINCT ?item) AS ?itemsClosed) WHERE { ?item a aegis:WorkItem ; aegis:assignedTo <{principal}> ; aegis:closedAt ?closedAt . } } { SELECT (SUM(?tokens) AS ?tokensConsumed) WHERE { ?record a aegis:UsageRecord ; aegis:inSession ?session ; aegis:tokensConsumed ?tokens . ?session aegis:actor <{principal}> . } } }
